messages.subject: New rclipboard package
parts:
Hi,

Just a quick note to announce the release on CRAN of the rclipboard package (https://cran.r-project.org/package=rclipboard).

This is a small package which provides a reactive copy-to-clipboard UI button component, called 'rclipButton', to use in Shiny apps. In the background, the package leverages the functionality of 'clipboard.js', a JavaScript library for HMTL5-based copy to clipboard from web pages (see <https://clipboardjs.com> for more information). So no reliance on Flash!

Note that this UI component unfortunately works only in apps deployed on a server, due to some limitations in the current RStudio web engine (see https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/1537 for more details), However, a simple workaround is illustrated in https://github.com/sbihorel/rclipboard for apps that need to be deployed for local use in RStudio in addition to remote use.

I hope this helps.

Sebastien
